name: trustlayer
description: TrustLayer browser extension, web client, and authentication backend.
author: lanzarote0tr <me@trillion-won.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names back,front "npm --workspace @trustlayer/back run dev" "npm --workspace @trustlayer/front run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace @trustlayer/back run build && npm --workspace @trustlayer/front run build && npm --workspace @trustlayer/extension run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @trustlayer/back run typecheck && npm --workspace @trustlayer/front run typecheck && npm --workspace @trustlayer/extension run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --workspace @trustlayer/front run lint && npm --workspace @trustlayer/extension run lint
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.clean: npm --workspace @trustlayer/back run clean && npm --workspace @trustlayer/front run clean && npm --workspace @trustlayer/extension run clean
